name: BOX, BOX, BOX
note: Formula 1 in the 2020s, from pit lane to podium

clues.clue: In 2023 a pit crew set the record by changing all four of these on a car in just 1.80 seconds
This Dutch driver won 19 races in the 2023 season alone, the most ever in a single year
In a 2025 blockbuster titled simply 'F1', this star played Sonny Hayes, a veteran making a comeback
This titanium hoop over the cockpit was credited with saving Romain Grosjean in a fiery 2020 crash
This Spaniard, a two-time world champion, was still racing in Formula 1 at age 44 in 2025
